chapter.verse: Topa in ka to kumpipa tungah, “Na galte nangma khe ngakna-in ka bawl matengin ka taklam khutah tu in,” a ci hi.
Topa in Zion panin na kumpi ciangkhut hong puak hi. Na galte’ lakah uk in!
Na mihonte mual siangtho tungah na makaih ciangin, utna lungsim tawh na mite hong kipia ding uh hi. Daitui bangin zingsang ciangin na khangnona nangma tungah hong tung ding hi.
Topa in thuciam zo a, ama ngaihsutna kheel lo ding hi. “Melkhizedek bangin nang in a tawntungin siampi na hi hi,” a ci hi.
Topa in nangma taklam-ah om hi; ama heh ni-in amah in kumpite zogawp ding hi.
Kumpipa in minamte lakah thukhen ding a, tua munte misi luang tawh dimsak ding hi; amah in a zai mahmah leitungah ukpite susia ding hi.
Amah in lampi gei-a luitui dawnin thahat ding a, amah a gualzo-in om ding hi.
